description.zh: 子节点按集合顺序排列，gap 控制间距。
description.en: Children follow collection order; gap sets their spacing.

examples.source:
use rs_lvgl_ui::prelude::*;

fn view(theme: &Theme) -> View<()> {
    column([
        label("Hello, LVGL")
            .font(theme.title_font)
            .text_color(theme.text),
        label("A screen is a tree of ordinary Rust values.")
            .font(theme.body_font)
            .text_color(theme.text),
        button("Start building").style(Style::accent(theme)),
    ])
    .style(Style::screen(theme))
    .font(theme.body_font)
    .text_color(theme.text)
    .padding(24)
    .gap(16)
}

description.zh: 用 grow 分配剩余空间，组织一行操作。
description.en: Distribute remaining space with grow in an action row.

examples.source:
use rs_lvgl_ui::prelude::*;

fn view(theme: &Theme) -> View<()> {
    let actions = row([
        button("Back").font(theme.body_font).text_color(theme.text),
        label("Step 2 of 3")
            .font(theme.body_font)
            .text_color(theme.text)
            .grow(1),
        button("Continue").style(Style::accent(theme)),
    ])
    .style(Style::surface(theme))
    .width(percent(100))
    .gap(12);

    column([
        label("Make room")
            .font(theme.title_font)
            .text_color(theme.text),
        label("The middle label grows into the available space."),
        actions,
    ])
    .style(Style::screen(theme))
    .font(theme.body_font)
    .text_color(theme.text)
    .padding(24)
    .gap(20)
}

description.zh: 轨道决定尺寸，grid_cell 决定位置和跨度。
description.en: Tracks set sizes; grid_cell sets position and span.

description.zh: 普通函数返回 View，复用结构与样式。
description.en: An ordinary function returns a View to share structure and style.

description.zh: 修改滑块、开关和按钮的初始外观。
description.en: Change the initial appearance of sliders, switches and buttons.

examples.source:
use rs_lvgl_ui::prelude::*;

fn view(theme: &Theme) -> View<()> {
    column([
        label("Device settings")
            .font(theme.title_font)
            .text_color(theme.text),
        row([
            label("Brightness")
                .font(theme.body_font)
                .text_color(theme.text),
            slider(0, 100, 64).width(px(240)).height(px(16)),
            label("64%"),
        ])
        .style(Style::surface(theme))
        .gap(24),
        row([label("Notifications"), switch(true)])
            .style(Style::surface(theme))
            .gap(24),
        button("Apply settings").style(Style::accent(theme)),
    ])
    .style(Style::screen(theme))
    .font(theme.body_font)
    .text_color(theme.text)
    .padding(24)
    .gap(24)
}

description.zh: 集合决定顺序，稳定的业务 ID 决定身份。
description.en: The collection determines order; stable business IDs determine identity.

examples.source:
use rs_lvgl_ui::prelude::*;

fn view(theme: &Theme) -> View<()> {
    let devices = [(41, "Studio"), (73, "Kitchen"), (92, "Bedroom")];
    let rows = devices.into_iter().map(|(id, name)| {
        row([
            label(name)
                .font(theme.body_font)
                .text_color(theme.text)
                .grow(1),
            label(format!("ID {id}"))
                .font(theme.body_font)
                .text_color(theme.muted),
        ])
        .key(Key::Id(id))
        .style(Style::surface(theme))
        .width(percent(100))
        .padding(16)
    });

    column([label("Your devices")
        .font(theme.title_font)
        .text_color(theme.text)])
    .children(rows)
    .style(Style::screen(theme))
    .font(theme.body_font)
    .text_color(theme.text)
    .padding(24)
    .gap(12)
}
